name: com.mrrcalendar/mrr-calendar
title: MRR Calendar
description: Read a founder's Stripe revenue day by day (MRR, ARR, projects, goals) and write calendar notes

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Start here. What MRR Calendar is, whether this client is connected, the granted scopes and shared projects, the account's plan and project count, and the links a person opens (connect Stripe, plans, Agents page). Works without a connection.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Public leaderboard of founders who chose to take part (public page active), sorted by a metric such as mrr. Public data, no connection needed.

sort.description: Metric to sort by; default mrr.

tools.name: list_public_events
tools.description: Recent public sales, subscriptions and milestones from founders' public pages, optionally for one founder (handle) or one SaaS (domain). Public data, no connection needed.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The projects this connection shares, with MRR, ARR, revenue, last sync and traffic, plus the revenue summary of those projects.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One shared project in detail: revenue, subscriptions, goals and recent activity. projectId comes from list_projects.

tools.name: get_revenue_calendar
tools.description: Revenue day by day for one year (confirmed and projected amounts, days with revenue only) over the shared projects or a subset, with the calendar notes of that year. On the free plan, days before limit.since are hidden: the result says so.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: The account's totals: MRR, ARR, active subscriptions, revenue today and over 30 days, one-time sales, daily GitHub commits and AI usage (all projects of the account).

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: The account's goals (MRR, revenue, commits, followers…) with target, current value and progress, and the milestones reached.

tools.name: set_calendar_note
tools.description: Writes the note of one day on the revenue calendar (one note per day: an existing note is replaced). Optionally tied to a shared project. Ask the person before replacing a note you did not write.

tools.name: delete_calendar_note
tools.description: Deletes the note of one day. Only when the person asks: the note cannot be restored.

tools.name: list_agent_connections
tools.description: This connection's rights (scopes, projects), connection date, last call and calls in the last 24 hours. With the agents:read scope, every AI agent connected to the account. No tokens or secrets.

tools.name: list_agent_activity
tools.description: Recorded MCP calls, newest first, over the last 90 days: tool, status, read or write, duration, error code. Never arguments or results. Without agents:read, only this connection's calls. Pass since to follow new calls.

clientId.description: Agent to show. Another agent than the caller requires agents:read.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Ends this agent's own connection: its tokens stop working at once and reconnecting needs the person's consent again. Only when the person asks, or to give back access a finished task no longer needs. It cannot disconnect any other agent.
